operating_earnings.rationale: Shared finite P/E screening band for positive source-bounded per-share earnings; it numerically reuses a prior operating screen, not a peer study or intrinsic cash-flow valuation.

filing_review_book.rationale: Conservative finite P/B screen while reported earnings are thin and an originally delayed audited filing needs specialist review; not a peer study or intrinsic value.

source.label: STI June FY2025 and 9M FY2026 PSE financial summary

STI.metric_label: TTM basic EPS through March 2026, June fiscal year

normalization.formula: 0.22 FY2025 basic EPS + 0.16 9M FY2026 EPS - 0.16 prior 9M EPS

STI.route_reason: Separate education subsidiaries and parent claims require attributable SOTP/FCFF; P/E is a finite screen based on aligned fiscal periods.
STI.intrinsic_blocker: Enrollment, tuition yield, campus reinvestment, leases, ownership, minority interests, and parent claims are not reconciled.
STI.source_warning: STI uses a June fiscal year; the March 2026 nine-month report is not a calendar-year half-year or a June 2026 annual refresh.

source.label: CEU May FY2025 and 9M FY2026 PSE financial summary

CEU.metric_label: TTM basic EPS through February 2026, May fiscal year

normalization.formula: 1.53 FY2025 basic EPS + 1.20 9M FY2026 EPS - 1.24 prior 9M EPS

CEU.route_reason: Student economics and campus assets require normalized FCFF; P/E is a finite screen on aligned May fiscal periods.
CEU.intrinsic_blocker: Enrollment and tuition mix, campus utilization, capital spending, leases, working capital, and terminal assumptions are not reconciled.
CEU.source_warning: CEU uses a May fiscal year and the latest PSE summary used here ends February 2026; a later annual filing is not silently substituted.

source.label: FEU May FY2026 PSE annual financial summary

FEU.metric_label: FY2026 PSE-reported basic EPS, May fiscal year

normalization.formula: FY2026 PSE-reported basic EPS; no interim annualization

FEU.route_reason: Education subsidiaries and property investments require attributable SOTP; annual EPS provides a separate finite P/E screen.
FEU.intrinsic_blocker: Subsidiary values, property interests, minorities, campus spending, leases, and parent claims are not reconciled.
FEU.source_warning: FEU uses a May fiscal year and has material non-parent equity; annual EPS is not a completed attributable SOTP.

source.label: MEDIC FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

normalization.formula: reported PHP book value per share; no earnings extrapolation

MEDIC.route_reason: Medical-device distribution cash flows require FCFF; reported book value provides only a finite screen while filing and earnings quality are reviewed.
MEDIC.intrinsic_blocker: Audited-filing reconciliation, government and private order economics, working capital, debt, capex, and terminal cash flows are incomplete.
MEDIC.source_warning: The FY2025 audit filing was delayed; PSE summary earnings are thin and rounded, so no P/E or intrinsic estimate is inferred from them.
